title: Secure Aggregation for Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning on Clinical EEG Data
abstract: arXiv:2607.28191v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Federated learning enables multiple institutions to collaboratively train a shared model without exchanging their raw data. However, individual model updates are data-dependent and may reveal information about clients' local training data. This paper presents a privacy-preserving federated learning framework for clinical EEG data that uses masking-based secure aggregation as its core protection mechanism. The framework combines graph-based communication, threshold secret sharing, dropout recovery, local update clipping, an optional Bloom filter-based privacy-preserving record-linkage initialization module, and auxiliary-notary-based verifiability. It supports semi-honest and malicious aggregation settings and is implemented using the Flower federated learning framework. The secure aggregation variants are evaluated in a simulated cross-silo healthcare setting using TUH EEG-derived data under different client configurations. Und

translated_title: 面向临床脑电数据隐私保护联邦学习的安全聚合
translated_abstract: 联邦学习使多个机构能够在不交换原始数据的情况下协同训练一个共享模型。然而，单个模型更新依赖于数据，可能会泄露客户端本地训练数据的信息。本文提出了一种面向临床脑电（EEG）数据的隐私保护联邦学习框架，该框架以基于掩码的安全聚合作为核心保护机制。该框架结合了基于图的通信、门限秘密共享、掉线恢复、本地更新裁剪、可选的基于布隆过滤器的隐私保护记录链接初始化模块，以及基于辅助公证人的可验证性。它支持半诚实和恶意聚合设置，并使用Flower联邦学习框架实现。在使用TUH脑电派生数据的模拟跨机构医疗环境中，对不同客户端配置下的安全聚合变体进行了评估。
tldr: 提出了一个以基于掩码的安全聚合为核心的临床脑电数据隐私保护联邦学习框架，结合图通信、门限秘密共享、掉线恢复、更新裁剪与可验证性机制，以抵御半诚实和恶意聚合方的信息泄露。
en_tdlr: Proposes a privacy-preserving federated learning framework for clinical EEG data centered on masking-based secure aggregation, combining graph-based communication, threshold secret sharing, dropout recovery, update clipping, and verifiability to defend against both semi-honest and malicious aggregators.
